responses:
I wouldn't send this offer yet. Of the three findings, one is correct, one cites a requirement the tender doesn't contain, and one misquotes the tender. The analysis also leaves out seven requirements, including two that can get the offer rejected.

## Findings check

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Tender 7.1 requires 5-year warranty; offer 5 years. Complies." | tender.md §7.1: *"Warranty: 24 months from the date of commissioning."* | APPLIES | §9 has no warranty override | **CONTRADICTED.** The tender asks for 24 months, not 5 years. Our 5 years still meets it, but the analysis misquotes the tender. You need to decide whether offering 5 years when 2 are required is on purpose (it costs more than the tender asks). |
| 2 | "Tender requires RAL 5015 (4.6). Offer RAL 5015. Complies." | **None.** The tender has no clause 4.6 (§4 ends at 4.5) and never mentions RAL, paint or finish. | UNKNOWN | n/a | **UNSUPPORTED.** The citation is made up. Don't put it in a compliance table sent to the customer. |
| 3 | "400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1). Offer 400 V 50 Hz. Complies." | tender.md §4.1: *"All equipment shall be suitable for a 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply."* | APPLIES (to all equipment, including the panels) | §9 has no override | **VERIFIED.** The offer line doesn't say "3-phase"; please confirm that's stated in the offer. |

## Requirements the analysis missed

| Clause | Requirement | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| **9.1 overrides 4.2** (precedence set by 9.3) | Pump motors above 75 kW must be **IE4** | **P-01 is 90 kW, so it needs IE4.** IE3 for P-01 would not comply. |
| 4.2 | Every other motor must be IE3 or better (IEC 60034-30-1) | P-02 (37 kW) needs IE3 or better. |
| **4.3 + Annex B** | Motors in Zone 1 areas need **ATEX Ex d** certification | P-01 is in the wet well, which is Zone 1, so it needs Ex d. P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so it doesn't. |
| 4.4 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | Not addressed. |
| 4.5 | Panel and motor terminal enclosures IP65 or better | Not addressed. |
| **7.4** | Delivery within 16 weeks of the purchase order. **Offers over 16 weeks are rejected.** | Not addressed. This one can get the offer rejected. |
| **9.2** | Ambient design temperature 50 °C | Not addressed. Standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C ambient, so the motors and panels may need derating or a 50 °C rating. Check the datasheets. |
| 9.3 | Section 9 overrides Sections 4 and 7 | The analysis never applies this precedence rule. |

## Summary

- **Results:** 1 verified, 1 contradicted, 1 unsupported, 0 needing a human decision (apart from the warranty question above).
- **Missed requirements:** 7 clauses (9.1/4.2, 4.3 with Annex B, 4.4, 4.5, 7.4, 9.2, 9.3).
- **Limitation:** I could only check what the analysis says about the offer, not the offer itself. The missed items need checking against the actual offer and datasheets.

**NO-GO.** Before sending:
1. Fix the warranty citation and decide whether to offer 24 months or 5 years.
2. Remove the RAL 5015 claim, or find where it comes from (maybe an addendum that isn't in the repo).
3. Confirm P-01 is IE4 and ATEX Ex d, P-02 is IE3 or better, enclosures are IP65 or better, cables are 2.5 mm² or more, equipment is rated for 50 °C ambient, and delivery is 16 weeks or less.
